method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Asian stocks bounce as AI, Mideast jitters recede; dollar firm on Fed bets
Equities.reason: Regional equity bounce after a tech/AI-led rout signals short‑term risk‑on sentiment returning; ties into broader market regime of AI leadership but tempered by macro (Fed) and geopolitical jitters — positive for equities overall.

Equities.title: Asian stocks rebound after AI rout
Equities.summary: Declines last week had pushed many indices into bear market territory
Equities.reason: Confirms the dominant narrative of an AI-led selloff then tentative stabilization in Asian markets — reinforces market regime story (AI leadership, high dispersion) and supports a modestly positive near‑term equities view.

Equities.title: Stock futures rise slightly as investors eye AI trade, brace for more data and earnings
Equities.reason: Modest futures lift driven by hopes of an AI rebound and upcoming data/earnings — positive but low signal and short‑term in nature (limited relevance to longer‑term regime).

Equities.title: UBS CEO says AI investors had been pricing for 'perfection' until sector's sharp correction
Equities.reason: Executive commentary highlights that AI was priced for perfection and that the sector’s correction reflects de‑risking — negative for AI leadership narrative and market risk appetite.

Equities.title: Nvidia’s Huang admits to affair after allegations of relationship with Chinese spy
Equities.summary: Silicon Valley chipmaker opens investigation into chief executive as he confirms extramarital liaison in message to employees
Equities.reason: High‑profile governance and national‑security allegations involving Nvidia's CEO pose material risk to the AI leadership narrative and can amplify sector selloffs and volatility — significant negative for market sentiment.

Equities.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
Equities.summary: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.
Equities.reason: Confirms and expands the Nvidia governance story — negative for investor confidence in the stock and the broader AI trade, though somewhat duplicative of other coverage (hence lower relevance).

Equities.title: Market Vulnerability Has Been Exposed for Good
Equities.reason: Broad assessment that recent events exposed market fragility underlines a higher systemic risk premium and increased volatility — negative for risk assets and supportive of caution among investors.

Equities.title: From celebration to mayhem: Wall Street’s 24-hour whiplash
Equities.reason: Captures extreme intramarket volatility as political/news events and the AI unwind collided — negative for near‑term risk sentiment and highlights rapid sentiment reversals.

Equities.title: Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
Equities.summary: Anthropic is poised to become the first pure-play AI company to hit the public market at a time when the public is increasingly leary of the industry.
Equities.reason: Timing and public backlash around a major AI IPO exacerbate concerns about valuation/speculative excess in the AI theme — modestly negative for sector appetite.

Equities.title: Wall Street Strategists Call Stock Rout a Fresh Reason to Buy
Equities.reason: Buy‑the‑dip narrative from strategists provides a countervailing flow supporting equities and may underpin tactical rebounds — positive but lower relevance versus structural risk signals.

Rates.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE raised bank rate to 4% — a clear tightening impulse that pushes yields higher (bond-selloff). High relevance for UK and global rates pricing and policy expectations.

Rates.title: Fed’s Daly says jobs data gives room for tightening policy
Rates.summary: San Francisco Federal Reserve (Fed) President Mary Daly said in an interview with CNBC on Friday that the job report was good news, that the economy is solid, and that it "gives latitude to get inflation job done.”
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official signals that strong jobs data supports further tightening — raises probability of higher-for-longer rates and upward pressure on Treasury yields.

Rates.title: Treasury Rally Gets New Boost as Election Hammers the AI Trade
Rates.reason: Headline indicates a fresh Treasury rally (yields falling) driven by a risk-off election move — meaningful near-term downward pressure on yields that can offset hawkish central-bank signals.

Rates.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
Rates.summary: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.
Rates.reason: Stronger-than-expected PPI in China implies upstream inflationary pressure that can feed into global inflation and increase rate-hike expectations — modest upward pressure on global yields.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker suggests slightly higher wage growth in first three quarters of 2027 compared with the full year of 2026
Rates.reason: ECB wage tracker pointing to firmer wages implies upside risk to inflation in the euro area — supports a higher-for-longer rates narrative and upward EUR-area yield bias.

Rates.title: Economic calendar: CPI, PPI and a flotilla of Fed speakers on weekly agenda
Rates.reason: Calendar highlights multiple inflation prints and Fed speakers — increases potential for rate-sensitive moves and intraday volatility; informational but not a direct policy action.

Rates.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
Rates.reason: Market-structure item: a domestic Treasury futures platform could improve liquidity and execution in the Treasury market — modest positive for market functioning and absorption of supply (limited direct price impact).

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as Fed hawkish outlook lifts USD/CHF
FX.summary: USD/CHF extends its gains for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8210 during Asian hours on Monday. However, the upside of the pair could be limited as the Greenback may face challenges due to a drop in crude oil prices. Lower oil prices help ease inf
FX.reason: Direct USD/CHF move driven by a hawkish Fed outlook — signals USD strength (negative for non‑USD currencies). Single‑pair focus limits relevance but Fed guidance is high‑impact for FX.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index remains subdued as lower oil prices ease inflation pressure
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground after two days of gains and trading around 102.20 during Asian hours on Monday.
FX.reason: DXY weakening is a broad USD signal (positive for non‑USD FX). Link to oil easing inflation adds macro relevance for rate/carry expectations across FX markets.

FX.title: Japanese Yen strengthens despite robust US jobs data
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair loses ground to near 158.25 during the early Asian session on Monday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) as Bank of Japan (BOJ) meeting minutes indicate policymakers are prepared to accelerate monetary tightening.
FX.reason: BOJ minutes signalling faster tightening are a material policy shift supporting JPY (positive for non‑USD FX). The story has clear central‑bank FX transmission and market impact.

FX.title: Euro advances on ECB rate hike expectations, weaker US Dollar
FX.summary: EUR/USD gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 1.1150 during Asian hours on Monday.
FX.reason: ECB hike expectations vs softer USD is a broad macro driver for EUR/USD and major currency indices — high‑relevance central bank narrative supporting non‑USD currencies.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains despite lower oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD loses ground after two days of gains, trading around 1.4110 during Asian hours on Monday. However, downside momentum could be restrained as the US Dollar (USD) may regain ground.
FX.reason: USD/CAD move shows CAD strength even as oil falls — direct commodity/FX transmission but mixed drivers reduce relevance slightly.

FX.title: Australian Dolllar edges lower to near 0.6850 on robust US jobs data
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair trades with mild losses around 0.6860 during the early Asian session on Monday. Stronger-than-expected US employment data provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).
FX.reason: US jobs supporting USD and pressuring AUD — clear USD‑centric transmission, moderate relevance as a routine macro data reaction.

FX.title: Malaysian Ringgit: Range consolidation view against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank's Charlie Lay and Dr. Henry Hao note that Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) held rates at 2.75% while maintaining a cautious stance. They expect a 25 bp hike in Q1 2027 and see USD/MYR consolidating within the 4.00–4.10 range.
FX.reason: Research note implying rangebound USD/MYR — low directional signal but relevant for MYR funding/positioning; limited market‑moving impact.

FX.title: Cross-Border Yuan Flows on China’s Network Head for Record Year
FX.reason: Record cross‑border CNY flows indicate stronger internationalisation/liquidity for the yuan — a significant structural FX theme supporting non‑USD currency options and capital flows.

FX.title: China to extend suspension of 24% US tariffs for two months from Nov. 10
FX.summary: China’s Finance Ministry said in a statement on Monday that it will extend the suspension of an additional 24% tariff on imports from the United States (US) for two months, effective November 10.
FX.reason: Temporary tariff suspension reduces bilateral trade friction — modestly positive for CNY/risk assets and non‑USD FX via improved trade outlook.

FX.title: Timetable and Schedule of U.S. Dollar Funds-Supplying Operations (November 2026-March 2027)
FX.reason: BOJ USD funds‑supplying operations schedule is an operational USD‑liquidity tool — relevant for USD funding conditions and USD/JPY dynamics (liquidity transmission into FX).

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar retreats following NFP-inspired rally
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Monday, November 9:
FX.reason: Market roundup highlighting DXY retreat after NFP moves — useful summary of the short‑term USD direction with direct FX transmission.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Stronger growth fails to lift sentiment – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG reports Indonesia’s Q3 GDP growth beat expectations at 5.47% year-on-year, helped by stronger exports and solid domestic demand. Private consumption and investment remained robust, reducing the urgency for Bank Indonesia to support activity. However, ling
FX.reason: Domestic growth beat but limited FX spill — MUFG view suggests muted sentiment/policy impact on IDR; small positive directional implication but low relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar Advances as Ruling Party Gets Election Edge
FX.reason: Political outcome lifting NZD — direct FX move tied to domestic political risk/policy outlook, medium relevance for antipodean FX positioning.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $53.00 as lower oil eases inflation pressure
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) appreciates after two days of losses, trading around $53.00 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday. Silver price advances as declining oil prices eased inflationary pressures.
Commodities.reason: Silver is moving higher in response to lower oil easing inflationary pressure (supports real metal demand as inflation expectations soften). This is a market-price reaction piece — positive but not structural.

Commodities.title: Gold gains more than 1% as softer oil prices ease inflation worries
Commodities.reason: Major wire coverage noting a >1% gold move tied to softer oil and lower inflation worries; broad precious metals reaction to macro (oil/ inflation/FX) — meaningful market impulse for gold.

Commodities.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
Commodities.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields
Commodities.reason: Shift away from gasoline toward distillates implies tighter gasoline (RBOB) availability — supportive for gasoline prices. Direct refinery/product mix signal relevant to petroleum product markets.

Commodities.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
Commodities.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million
Commodities.reason: Material drop in global refinery throughput after the regional conflict reduced crude processing/demand — overall negative for crude product demand and oil-price support in the quarter; meaningful supply-demand data.

Commodities.title: Gold rises amid US-Iran peace deal hopes, softer US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground above $4,020 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The prospects of diplomacy in the US-Iran conflict and weaker US Dollar (USD) boost the precious metal.
Commodities.reason: Diplomacy lowering geopolitical risk and a softer USD are direct bullish inputs for gold; reinforces the broader precious-metals rally narrative seen in other coverage.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Rise as US Presses China to Boost Farm Goods Purchases
Commodities.reason: Policy/diplomatic push to increase Chinese purchases is a concrete demand-side lift for US soybeans — supportive for soybean prices with meaningful demand implications.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
Commodities.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. crude inflows from Venezuela increase supply to the U.S. market — a modest negative for WTI/crude balances and near-term price pressure.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Hurricane-driven Gulf production shut-ins are classic short-term supply shocks — supportive for crude and regional petroleum-product prices.

Commodities.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.
Commodities.reason: Regional price move confirmation for gold (India market) — supportive but lower relevance than wire coverage; local demand/price datapoint.

Commodities.title: WTI falls to near $89.50 as Trump hints at reduced US-Iran tension
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price loses ground after remaining nearly flat in the previous day, trading around $89.60 during Asian hours on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Market reaction to lower geopolitical risk (comments suggesting reduced US-Iran tension) — immediate negative impulse for WTI prices.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: Doji standoff puts $49.00 support at risk
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) price consolidates near $52.00, up a minimal 0.19% on Friday as the Greenback rallies sharply, posting strong US data. Back-to-back ‘doji’ candles indicate that neither buyers nor sellers are in control.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-action piece noting USD strength and indecision — a negative technical signal for silver but limited structural relevance (technical analysis capped relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks 'unlikely'
Commodities.reason: Wire report linking comments that lower the risk premium on Iran-related supply disruptions to an immediate oil price decline — clear negative for oil with above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Extends Biggest Weekly Decline Since 2020 With Focus on Iran
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg coverage highlighting a large weekly oil selloff centered on reduced Iran risk — significant market-moving theme (larger magnitude negative for oil given scale of move).

Crypto.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
Crypto.reason: Major US Treasury enforcement action against a large exchange is a high-impact regulatory shock that raises counterparty risk, onshore/offshore flows disruption and broader market de-risking.

Crypto.title: The Shadowy Crypto Services Helping the Binance Hackers Launder Stolen Billions
Crypto.reason: Revelations about large-scale laundering networks tied to major hacks increase regulatory scrutiny and reputational/legal risk across exchanges and custodians, negative for market trust and flows.

Crypto.title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
Crypto.reason: Large liquidations combined with weak/neutral ETF spot flows point to fragile leverage and limited structural bid into spot, increasing downside vulnerability.

Crypto.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
Crypto.reason: Stronger-than-expected payrolls raise the odds of persistent Fed tightness/higher rates, a negative macro impulse for crypto risk assets and leveraged positioning.

Crypto.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
Crypto.reason: A user-data and wallet-linked breach undermines consumer trust and raises security/regulatory concerns for on-ramps and payment services.

Crypto.title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
Crypto.reason: Mining-pool disruption tied to regulatory/operational shutdowns increases short-term hash-rate centralization risk and operational uncertainty for miners.

Crypto.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level remediation to remove an exploited feature reduces future smart-contract attack surface and supports longer-term network security and confidence.

Crypto.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
Crypto.reason: A major privacy/tech upgrade that improves payment speed is a positive on-chain adoption signal for privacy-preserving use cases.

Crypto.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
Crypto.reason: Major tech platforms declining to support tokenized stock initiatives slows mainstream distribution channels and weakens the tokenization adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
Crypto.reason: New domestic taxation on crypto gains/DeFi income is a localized drag on demand and may set precedents for regional tax treatments.

Crypto.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
Crypto.reason: Regulatory action to block an exchange acquisition increases jurisdictional risk for offshore exchanges and may reduce regional liquidity/access.

Crypto.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
Crypto.reason: Mixed signal: slower stablecoin supply growth tempers on-chain liquidity, but continued payments adoption indicates real-activity use cases that are modestly positive for long-term demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops, then pops as Nvidia cheating scandal and failed Iran talks trigger volatility
Crypto.reason: Event-driven headlines tied to macro/geopolitical shocks are driving short-term BTC volatility and indicate elevated risk-off intraday moves.
